<!--
Everything in this sim comes from the client's data tables. Nothing has been checked
against a running game, so anything measured in-game is worth more than anything else
you could send.

Attach files by dragging them into this box. Drop whatever you have - a partial report
is still useful, and you do not need all three sections.
-->

## What you measured

## The numbers

<!--
Best first:

1. A screenshot of Forever's own damage meter at the end of the fight. Addons cannot
   read damage in Forever, so the client's meter is the only in-game source of it.
2. A combat log - /combatlog, then Logs/WoWCombatLog.txt. Only useful if your client
   writes damage into it. If it does, say so; that is a bigger deal than one parse.
3. A single-ability test: cast one rank of one spell at a dummy 20+ times and give the
   meter's total plus your spell power or attack power. That pins one coefficient
   exactly, which a whole fight cannot.
-->
